versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת בְּנֵי־נֹ֔חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וַיִּוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם בָּנִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃

controles.web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
controles.kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
controles.livre: Estas são as gerações dos filhos de Noé: Sem, Cam e Jafé, aos quais nasceram filhos depois do dilúvio.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃

controles.web: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
controles.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Jafé: Gômer, e Magogue, e Madai, e Javã, e Tubal, e Meseque, e Tiras.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְרִיפַ֖ת וְתֹגַרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Gômer: Asquenaz, e Rifate, e Togarma.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּתִּ֖ים וְדֹדָנִֽים׃

controles.web: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Javã: Elisá, e Társis, Quitim, e Dodanim.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֠אֵלֶּה נִפְרְד֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ בְּאַרְצֹתָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לִלְשֹׁנ֑וֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
controles.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
controles.livre: Por estes foram repartidas as ilhas das nações em suas terras, cada qual segundo sua língua, conforme suas famílias em suas nações.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּפ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Cam: Cuxe, e Mizraim, e Pute, e Canaã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥ה וְרַעְמָ֖ה וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖ה שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃

controles.web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Cuxe: Sebá, Havilá, e Sabtá, e Raamá, e Sabtecá. E os filhos de Raamá: Sabá e Dedã.

versos.hebraico: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־נִמְרֹ֑ד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽהְי֥וֹת גִּבֹּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
controles.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
controles.livre: E Cuxe gerou a Ninrode, este começou a ser poderoso na terra.

versos.hebraico: הֽוּא־הָיָ֥ה גִבֹּֽר־צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר כְּנִמְרֹ֛ד גִּבּ֥וֹר צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.
controles.kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.
controles.livre: Este foi vigoroso caçador diante do SENHOR; pelo qual se diz: Assim como Ninrode, vigoroso caçador diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַתְּהִ֨י רֵאשִׁ֤ית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶ֖רֶךְ וְאַכַּ֣ד וְכַלְנֵ֑ה בְּאֶ֖רֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃

controles.web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
controles.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
controles.livre: E foi a cabeceira de seu reino Babel, e Ereque, e Acade, e Calné, na terra de Sinear.

versos.hebraico: מִן־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא יָצָ֣א אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת־נִ֣ינְוֵ֔ה וְאֶת־רְחֹבֹ֥ת עִ֖יר וְאֶת־כָּֽלַח׃

controles.web: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
controles.kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
controles.livre: De esta terra saiu Assur, e edificou a Nínive, e a Reobote-Ir, e a Calá,

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶת־רֶ֔סֶן בֵּ֥ין נִֽינְוֵ֖ה וּבֵ֣ין כָּ֑לַח הִ֖וא הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
controles.kjv: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
controles.livre: E a Resém entre Nínive e Calá; a qual é cidade grande.

versos.hebraico: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־לוּדִ֧ים וְאֶת־עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃

controles.web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
controles.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
controles.livre: E Mizraim gerou a Ludim, e a Anamim, e a Leabim, e a Naftuim,

versos.hebraico: וְֽאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
controles.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
controles.livre: E a Patrusim, e a Casluim de onde saíram os filisteus, e a Caftorim.

versos.hebraico: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־צִידֹ֥ן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֵֽת׃

controles.web: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
controles.kjv: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
controles.livre: E Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito e a Hete,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
controles.kjv: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
controles.livre: E aos jebuseus, e aos amorreus, e aos gergeseus,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַֽחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־הַסִּינִֽי׃

controles.web: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
controles.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
controles.livre: E aos heveus, e aos arqueus, e aos sineus,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָֽאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְאַחַ֣ר נָפֹ֔צוּ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃

controles.web: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
controles.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
controles.livre: E aos arvadeus e aos zemareus, e aos hamateus: e depois se derramaram as famílias dos cananeus.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִצִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲכָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָה עַד־עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲכָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָה וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאַדְמָ֥ה וּצְבֹיִ֖ם עַד־לָֽשַׁע׃

controles.web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
controles.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
controles.livre: E foi o termo dos cananeus desde Sidom, vindo a Gerar até Gaza, até entrar em Sodoma e Gomorra, Admá, e Zeboim até Lasa.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־חָ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹֽׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
controles.livre: Estes são os filhos de Cam por suas famílias, por suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.

versos.hebraico: וּלְשֵׁ֥ם יֻלַּ֖ד גַּם־ה֑וּא אֲבִי֙ כָּל־בְּנֵי־עֵ֔בֶר אֲחִ֖י יֶ֥פֶת הַגָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: Children were also born to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth.
controles.kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
controles.livre: Também lhe nasceram filhos a Sem, pai de todos os filhos de Héber, e irmão mais velho de Jafé.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֥י שֵׁ֖ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֑וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֥וּד וַֽאֲרָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
controles.kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Sem: Elão, e Assur, e Arfaxade, e Lude, e Arã.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י אֲרָ֑ם ע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמַֽשׁ׃

controles.web: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
controles.kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Arã: Uz, e Hul, e Géter, e Mas.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃

controles.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
controles.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
controles.livre: E Arfaxade gerou a Salá, e Salá gerou a Héber.

versos.hebraico: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָֽאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃

controles.web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
controles.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
controles.livre: E a Héber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porque em seus dias foi repartida a terra; e o nome de seu irmão, Joctã.

versos.hebraico: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־יָֽרַח׃

controles.web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
controles.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
controles.livre: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, e a Salefe, e Hazarmavé, e a Jerá,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־דִּקְלָֽה׃

controles.web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
controles.kjv: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
controles.livre: E a Hadorão, e a Uzal, e a Dicla,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עוֹבָ֥ל וְאֶת־אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־שְׁבָֽא׃

controles.web: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
controles.kjv: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
controles.livre: E a Obal, e a Abimael, e a Sabá,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אוֹפִ֥ר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃

controles.web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
controles.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
controles.livre: E a Ofir, e a Havilá, e a Jobabe: todos estes foram filhos de Joctã.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִ֥י מוֹשָׁבָ֖ם מִמֵּשָׁ֑א בֹּאֲכָ֥ה סְפָ֖רָה הַ֥ר הַקֶּֽדֶם׃

controles.web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
controles.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
controles.livre: E foi sua habitação desde Messa vindo de Sefar, monte à parte do oriente.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־שֵׁ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם לְגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Sem por suas famílias, por suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֧ת בְּנֵי־נֹ֛חַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶ֑ם וּמֵאֵ֜לֶּה נִפְרְד֧וּ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃פ

controles.web: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
controles.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
controles.livre: Estas são as famílias de Noé por suas descendências, em suas nações; e destes foram divididas os povos na terra depois do dilúvio.
